message_1_subject: Coord: ClearBay multi-stakeholder demo — proposed times and checklist
message_1_body:
Hi Maya / David —

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood. Per our call, we'd like to run a 60–75 minute technical walkthrough focused on: model selection & cost profiles, VPC onboarding, and how Dedicated / Private would map to ClearBay's SRE + procurement controls.

Proposed time slots (PDT):
- Tue Sep 14, 11:00–12:15
- Wed Sep 15, 09:00–10:15

Attendees we suggest: AE (Sean), SE (Laura), infra lead (Dev), your SRE and procurement rep.

I've attached a draft agenda and a short VPN/onboarding checklist to streamline access. Please let me know which slot works or share two alternatives. If procurement needs a short pre-call to confirm evidence required, we can schedule that separately.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
attachments: clearbay_demo_agenda.pdf (PDF), vpn_onboarding.txt (text)

message_3_subject: Re: Coord: ClearBay multi-stakeholder demo — proposed times and checklist
message_3_body:
Maya — totally understand, hope the incident is contained quickly.

Laura, Dev — can you hold Mon 9/20 10:00 and Tue 9/21 14:00 for ClearBay? If the SRE team prefers, we can split the session: an initial procurement+security 30m, then a follow-up SE deep-dive for the SREs. That might reduce the friction while they triage.

Also looping in our CS lead (Laura) to offer a short procurement pre-call if that helps. If procurement still needs more time, we can ask our Ops team for an SLA exception (we have a precedent for a one-time pre-schedule priority slot for active deals). Jasmine — are you comfortable escalating for an SLA exception if needed?

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

message_4_subject: Final: ClearBay demo moved to Mon Sep 20 10:00 PDT — agenda + calendar link
message_4_body:
Thanks everyone — we can do Mon 20 at 10:00–11:15 PDT.

I've booked the slot and updated the calendar invite (see hub link below). Laura will lead the SE portion and Dev will be available for the VPC/networking discussion. Sean — thanks for offering the SLA exception; I didn't need to escalate after all — ClearBay picked the Mon slot.

Quick notes for the session:
- 10:00–10:15: Intro + procurement evidence checklist (procurement rep)
- 10:15–10:50: SE deep-dive (architecture, KV cache / batching demo)
- 10:50–11:15: Q&A + next steps / pilot kickoff

Attachments: clearbay_demo_agenda.pdf, vpn_onboarding.txt
Calendar: https://cal.example.com/jasmine/clearbay-mon-20260920
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/CB-2026-1142
